CodeListItem.Decode: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

CodeList.Name: Action Taken with Study Treatment Codelist

CodeListItem.Decode: 0 - Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
1 - Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out light work
2 - Ambulatory and capable of all selfcare but unable to carry out any work activities
3 - Capable of only limited selfcare; confined to bed or chair >50% of waking hours
4 - Completely disabled; cannot carry on any selfcare

RuleDef.Name: Post-Discontinuation / Death Chronology Guard

RuleAction.Message: No clinical assessment, laboratory draw, or dosing date may occur after subject discontinuation/death or in the future.
RuleAction.TranslatedText: No clinical assessment, laboratory draw, or dosing date may occur after subject discontinuation/death or in the future.

RuleDef.Name: Eligibility Confirmation Prior to Study Dosing
RuleDef.Expression: ITEM.Inclusion Criteria == 'ELIGIBLE' and ITEM.Intervention_Type is not None

RuleAction.Message: Subject cannot receive study treatment on FORM.EX if any Inclusion Criterion is unmet or any Exclusion Criterion is triggered on FORM.IE.
RuleAction.TranslatedText: Subject cannot receive study treatment on FORM.EX if any Inclusion Criterion is unmet or any Exclusion Criterion is triggered on FORM.IE.

RuleDef.Name: Adverse Event Concomitant Medication Reconciliation
RuleDef.Expression: FORM.AE.AECONTRT != 'Y' or ITEM.Permitted Medications is not None

RuleAction.Message: Adverse Event indicates concomitant medication treatment was given; a corresponding medication entry must be logged on FORM.CM.
RuleAction.TranslatedText: Adverse Event indicates concomitant medication treatment was given; a corresponding medication entry must be logged on FORM.CM.

RuleDef.Name: Longitudinal Weight Change >= 10% BSA & Dose Recalculation

RuleAction.Message: Subject body weight changed by > 10% from baseline; verify weight entry and recalculate Body Surface Area (BSA) and dosing.
RuleAction.TranslatedText: Subject body weight changed by > 10% from baseline; verify weight entry and recalculate Body Surface Area (BSA) and dosing.

RuleDef.Name: QTcF Longitudinal Increase > 60 ms from Baseline (ICH E14)

RuleAction.Message: QTcF interval increased by > 60 ms from baseline (ICH E14 cardiac safety threshold); requires triplicate ECG confirmation and cardiology evaluation.
RuleAction.TranslatedText: QTcF interval increased by > 60 ms from baseline (ICH E14 cardiac safety threshold); requires triplicate ECG confirmation and cardiology evaluation.
